verdict.rationale: Mailchimp markets automations as a core feature, and its pricing tiers list 'Enhanced automations'. Its AI analytics reference automations driving revenue, and a community user mentions building a Mailchimp automation. Background execution is shown by RSS campaigns that send on their own schedule and by event-driven transactional messages and webhooks, but the pack never documents how users actually set up automation flows. Missing for 10: documentation of the automation builder, its triggers and multi-step journeys, AI or agent-driven setup of automations, and hands-on corroboration that automations run unattended.
